collectible:1.text: Trading cards are a category of collectibles found in The Last of Us Part II and are only collected by Ellie. They appear as trading cards of a fictional collectible card game known as Society of Champions. The trading cards are a part of the same fictional franchise as the Savage Starlight comics found in The Last of Us, as a card can be found featuring the comic's protagonist, Dr. Daniela Star.

collectible:4.text: Ellie's journal is an artifact that is found during the "Jackson" chapter in The Last of Us Part II. It is an old journal owned by Ellie. Here she draws and writes her thoughts throughout the game. Ellie's journal can be found in her house on a desk close to her jacket. It is automatically picked up when she leaves to go on patrol with Dina.
